release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.35 is a focused hotfix for two regressions introduced in v0.45.34. The seven-tab navigation no longer runs a continuous DOM mutation/reordering loop, restoring reliable tab clicks throughout the desktop shell. The Update Available dialog is now strictly black, graphite, and white; the later visual-correction layer no longer reintroduces blue or cyan styling over the monochrome updater. Regression coverage now explicitly forbids the continuous navigation MutationObserver and forbids the legacy blue updater accents. No task execution, checkout, cookie/session, or retail backend behavior was changed.
